senses.gloss: (v. בסס) to trample upon; hence (with ב־) to despise; v. בְּזֵי I; cmp. בְּטַשׁ.

<cite ref="B00980">same</cite>. Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46ᶜ <he>לא מבסי לא ברומי וכ׳</he> (read <he>תְבַסֵּי</he>) despise neither a Roman of low standing &c.; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>לא תבזון</he>).

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite>, end, heard an Arab say to his neighbor <he>מה את מְבַסֵּה בי וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>מכ׳</he>, corr. acc.) why art thou driving me? and he meant to say <he>מה את מְעַשֶּׂה בי</he> (Var. <he>מְעַסֶּה</he>) why wilt thou force me?—from which they learned the meaning of <he>ועסותם</he>, <cite ref="Malachi 3:21">Mal. III, 21</cite>.
